NETTLE.gloss: any of numerous plants having stinging hairs that cause skin irritation on contact
NETTLE.definition: Any of numerous plants having stinging hairs that cause skin irritation on contact (especially of the genus Urtica or family Urticaceae).

TENET.gloss: a religious doctrine that is proclaimed as true without proof
TENET.definition: A religious doctrine that is proclaimed as true without proof.

TENT.definition: A portable shelter (usually of canvas stretched over supporting poles and fastened to the ground with ropes and pegs).
TENT.example: He pitched his tent near the creek.

LET.gloss: make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen
LET.definition: Make it possible through a specific action or lack of action for something to happen.
LET.example: This permits the water to rush in.

TEN.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one
TEN.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system.

NET.gloss: a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the…
NET.definition: A computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange.

LEE.gloss: the side of something that is sheltered from the wind
LEE.definition: The side of something that is sheltered from the wind.

TEE.gloss: the starting place for each hole on a golf course
TEE.definition: The starting place for each hole on a golf course.
TEE.example: They were waiting on the first tee.
